nodes.description: mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) tracking member balances per underlying asset; written during deposit/topup/liquidateBorrow/withdraw.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) tracking member topped-up amounts per underlying asset.
mapping(address => TopupInfo) tracking per-avatar top-up and liquidation info, including member amounts and debt to liquidate.
address[] list of authorized liquidator/member addresses used by onlyMember checks and round robin selection.
IRegistry instance resolving owners, avatars and Compound/BProtocol addresses.

IBComptroller reference mapping BTokens to CTokens.
address of Compound cEther used to detect ETH market.
mapping(address => uint) minimum debt size above which debt is shared among members.
Duration a small topup is held before another member may replace it.
Duration used in round-robin member selection for small topups.
Only-member function that computes liquidation amounts, calls ICushion.liquidateBorrow with value, updates balances and shares seized collateral.
Only-member function that validates top-up size vs debt, updates topup bookkeeping and forwards funds to the avatar cushion.
Only-member entry point that relays to internal _untop to return topped-up funds to a member.
Internal untop logic validating amount limits, remaining liquidation amount and updating balance/topupBalance/bookkeeping.
Withdraws member balance; for ETH uses msg.sender.transfer, otherwise uses SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
Only-member deposit of ETH or ERC20 into member balance.
External function that posts prices to the oracle and then calls liquidateBorrow with caller-supplied parameters.
Splits seized cTokens between the liquidating member and the jar using shareNumerator/shareDenominator.
Only-owner function performing an arbitrary low-level call with value to any target.
Round-robin winner selection using keccak256 over avatar and block.timestamp/selectionDuration.
Reads current debt via IBToken.borrowBalanceCurrent and computes min/max topup and small-debt flag.
Iterates members and untops them based on cushion size, expiry timestamps and small/big debt flag.
Only-owner one-time registry setter that caches comptroller, bComptroller and cEther.
Internal loop checking whether an address is in the members array.
Caller-controlled address used for member checks, balance accounting and fund transfers.
Block timestamp (now) used in topup expiry logic and round-robin selection, a timestamp dependency.
External payable call to ICushion(avatar).liquidateBorrow passing ETH value; executes external code before share accounting.
Native ETH transfer to msg.sender during withdraw.
Arbitrary low-level call forwarding value to an owner-supplied target in emergencyExecute.
ERC20 token transfer to msg.sender via SafeERC20 during withdraw.
ERC20 transfer of seized collateral to member and jar in _shareLiquidationProceeds.
External payable call to ICushion(avatar).topup forwarding member funds to the avatar cushion.
Borrower user address whose avatar is being liquidated.
Caller-supplied underlying amount to liquidate.
BToken address of the collateral seized during liquidation.
BToken address of the debt being repaid during liquidation.

Member-supplied amount to top up into the avatar cushion.
BToken identifying the debt market to top up.
Underlying asset to withdraw (ETH sentinel or ERC20 address).
Computed amount deducted from the cushion topup during liquidation.
Computed amount the member repays on Compound during liquidation.

edges.reason: liquidateBorrow reads and decrements balance[msg.sender][debtUnderlying] as part of liquidation accounting.
liquidateBorrow reads and mutates topped[avatar] member info including amountTopped/amountLiquidated.
liquidateBorrow passes computed repay amounts into the external ICushion.liquidateBorrow value call.
liquidateBorrow calls _shareLiquidationProceeds to distribute seized collateral after repaying debt.
topup reads and debits balance[msg.sender][underlying] for the member.
topup adds the amount to topupBalance[msg.sender][underlying].
topup writes info.cToken and memberInfo amount/expire in the topped mapping.
topup forwards the member amount into the external ICushion.topup value call, an unsafe external operation.
topup calls getDebtTopupInfo to obtain min/max topup bounds and small-debt flag.
topup calls _untopOnMembers to release existing topups before applying the new one.
untop delegates to internal _untop after the onlyMember modifier.
_untop credits balance[member][underlying] with the returned amount.
_untop reduces topupBalance[member][underlying].
_untop reads and zeroes the member's topped info (amountTopped, expire).
_untop resolves the avatar through registry.avatarOf(user).
withdraw decrements balance[msg.sender][underlying] (or ETH_ADDR).
withdraw sends native ETH to msg.sender via transfer for ETH withdrawals.
withdraw sends ERC20 funds to msg.sender via SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
deposit credits balance[msg.sender][underlying] with the deposited ETH or token amount.
feedPricesAndLiquidate posts oracle prices then calls liquidateBorrow with the caller-supplied parameters.
_shareLiquidationProceeds transfers seized cTokens to member and jar via safeTransfer.
_shareLiquidationProceeds uses shareNumerator/shareDenominator to compute member and jar shares.
emergencyExecute performs an arbitrary low-level call forwarding msg.value to target.
smallTopupWinner uses block.timestamp (now) in the winner-selection hash, a timestamp dependency.
getDebtTopupInfo derives min/max topup from debt which is backed by member balances recorded in Pool.
_untopOnMembers invokes _untopOnBehalf which calls _untop for each member.
_untopOnMembers reads topped[avatar] member info including amountTopped and expire.
setRegistry assigns the registry state variable.
setRegistry caches the comptroller from the registry.
setRegistry caches the bComptroller from the registry.
msg.sender must pass the onlyMember check and is used as the liquidating member in liquidateBorrow.
msg.sender must be a member and provides balance/topup bookkeeping keys in topup.
withdraw operates on the caller's own balances and transfers to msg.sender.
balance mapping is indexed by member address controlled by msg.sender across topup/liquidateBorrow/withdraw.
withdraw sends ETH directly to the caller-controlled msg.sender address.
topup compares memberInfo.expire against block.timestamp to decide topup validity, a timestamp dependency.
smallTopupWinner selection depends on block.timestamp / selectionDuration, a timestamp dependency.
_untopOnMembers requires memberInfo.expire < now, making behaviour order depend on block.timestamp.
The external ICushion.liquidateBorrow value call executes before balance/topupBalance state updates, allowing reentrant reads of stale accounting.
The external ICushion.topup value call can re-enter before all topped/balance effects are finalized, exposing reentrancy.
withdraw performs msg.sender.transfer which transfers control to the recipient and interacts with the same accounting state without a reentrancy guard.

normalization_plan.reason: Borrower address parameter is only meaningful inside liquidateBorrow where it resolves the avatar being liquidated.
Underlying liquidation amount parameter drives computations and the ICushion.liquidateBorrow external call inside liquidateBorrow.
Collateral BToken parameter is resolved to cTokenCollateral and used for seized-collateral sharing in liquidateBorrow.
Debt BToken parameter is resolved to cTokenDebt and drives the member balance repayment in liquidateBorrow.
User parameter is used solely within topup to resolve the target avatar and its debt info.
Amount parameter determines balance/topupBalance adjustments and the external ICushion.topup call in topup.
BToken parameter is mapped to the cToken debt market used throughout topup.
Underlying parameter selects between the ETH transfer and ERC20 safeTransfer branches inside withdraw.
Intermediate cushion-deduction amount computed and applied only within liquidateBorrow accounting.
Intermediate Compound-repayment amount derived and consumed only in liquidateBorrow.
Per-member liquidation quota computed and stored within liquidateBorrow to bound each liquidation.
